arms.P2: 200 Adam + 50 fresh Adam lr 0.01 polish, paired C1

sanity.rows: 48 O1 delivered rows, eight parents, seed 11, CPU eager
sanity.polish_gate: median delivered score must not fall and median fraction of O1 L-BFGS score gain recovered >= 0.25
sanity.A1_gate: full solve of eight O1 parents; median delivered top-1 score must not fall versus C0

primary: paired top-1 delta E_unrel, mean with parent-clustered bootstrap 95% CI and median
secondary: obscene rate (>200 kJ/mol), all delivered rows
order: nine-parent CPU trope suite, no strain; filter only, no inferential CI
tail seeds 11,12,13 on local 2060, paired local control
cal seeds 11,12,13 only on tail pass or ambiguous tail with better mean
trope_filter: score rises on most parents, paired median top-1 delta E_unrel <= 0, guard holds
panel_pass: tail primary CI upper <0 OR cal primary upper <2 kJ/mol AND floor or obscene-rate improvement CI excludes 0

guards.parent_regression: no parent worsens >25 kJ/mol in top-1 delta E_unrel on >=2/3 seeds

failure_policy: record failures and continue; never impute zero; report incomplete pairing and do not declare pass on incomplete gates
prohibited: relaxation during development, val/reserve/locked sets, G-3b before audit
checkpoint: G-3a: report, commit, stop for audit
trope_seed_note: All nine parents and paired controls use three seeds so the >=2/3 regression guard is observable; no CI claimed for nine parents.
